title: Stealth tension
comment: Played over any region track (exclusive: false). Unpitched on purpose: only the perc voice (thuds, knocks, clicks, ticks, shakers, breaths), so it sits under any key. 120 bpm with 8 beats to the bar = a 4 s bar, the same bar as every region track: bar-quantised entries line up. 4 bars. Stack by the highest scout state near the player: INVESTIGATE = watched; WARN = watched + warned; CHASE = watched + warned + hunted; SEARCH = search alone, the others fading out.

layers.comment: watched: a slow low pulse once a bar and a soft tick: you are being looked for
warned: a low beat on 3 and 7 (never on the watched pulse, so the low end does not pile up), a quick knock after it like a heartbeat, knocks tighten the grid
hunted: a driving sixteenth grid of clicks and shaker, knocks on 5-in-16, thuds on beats 2 and 6 between the others
layers.pattern: [~ thud ~ ~ ~ thud ~ ~], [click shaker? click? shaker]*8, knock(5,16,3)

layers.comment: search (the decay state): breaths and a lone tick, the pulse gone: they lost you, they are still there
